description: Mathematical invariant: defender crew applies Burning (1% max hull/round, 5 rounds duration) to attacker via counter-fire. Attacker hull=3000 → 30 dmg/round from Burning. Defender crew refreshes duration to 5 each RoundStart. Attacker takes 30×5 = 150 Burning + 50×5 = 250 counter-fire = 400 total hull damage over 5 rounds. Final attacker hull: 3000 - 400 = 2600.
